name: Cortes de Baza (Spain)
description: A red hoist stripe of one third bearing a white tower, the fly of three horizontal stripes, white, blue and white.
history: Cortes de Baza has its own arms and flag, although they have not been made official under the regional regulations, which does not prevent their widespread use; the flag is rectangular of 2:3, formed of three equal horizontal stripes, white at the edges and blue in the centre, with a vertical stripe of 1/3 of the length next to the hoist.

features.role: fly tricolour white, blue and white
